Practical questions

Do you publish prices online?

No. Each horse and stay is discussed individually. Contact us for current information.

Can I enquire about a horse for sale?

Yes. We welcome enquiries from foals through to competition horses. Availability is shared privately.

How do I book a house?

Use the official booking link on each house page for live availability and booking conditions.

Can transporters arrive without notice?

Please arrange every arrival with the haras in advance so we can provide the correct access instructions.
